proof_boundary: This proves the exact outer-remainder split, completed relative lifts and tie invariance, Hermitian/transpose mixed-current compression into two degree-five functionals, terminal endpoint reductions, lower conditional traces, and a carrier-bilinear factorization. It proves no signed lower/interior estimate, complete outer-complement or quadratic residual bound, signed full-current or Phi_B theorem, contact exclusion, retained aggregate or Xi theorem, Q209, Lambda<=0, PF-infinity, RH, or prize-level conclusion.

rows.proof_boundary: Absolute convergence begins only after reassembly.

rows.proof_boundary: The terminal and remainder pieces are not estimated separately here.

rows.claim: Relative lifts reproduce the exact phase difference and phase sum on every carrier atom.
rows.proof_boundary: This does not sign either sum.

rows.claim: The completed relative lifts are invariant under a half-open mode transfer.
rows.proof_boundary: Only the joined carrier plus remainder is differentiated.

rows.proof_boundary: The fixed endpoint edge remains external.

rows.proof_boundary: Degree closure is not a size bound.

rows.proof_boundary: Its coefficient still depends on the physical row.
